text: {"assertions":["A bug in platform/config/loader.py caused wrong environment configuration for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys.","The root cause of the wrong environment bug was an unbounded retry loop with no backoff.","The wrong environment bug manifested as production endpoints being called from staging processes.","The wrong environment bug could be reproduced by starting the service with an unset profile variable.","The fix implemented in PR #3409 capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter.","The fix was developed on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","After the fix, cold start performance improved by 98 percent, dropping to 840 milliseconds."]}
